related_questions.question: What is the main difference between COVID-19 and influenza?
related_questions.snippet: Influenza (flu) and COVID-19 are both contagious respiratory illnesses, but they are caused by different viruses. COVID-19 is caused by infection with a coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) first identified in 2019. Flu is caused by infection with an influenza virus. From what we know, COVID-19 spreads more easily than flu.
